description: We are a team of senior Computer Systems Engineering students from the Instituto Tecnológico de Saltillo in Coahuila, Mexico. Yes, our name is Terraplanistas (Flat-Earthers), but don’t worry: we came to Space Apps to prove with NASA data that the Earth is round… and that with code, creativity and plenty of coffee, we can tackle real challenges for our planet.
summary:
Prometeo is an interactive, scientific-paper-style report that answers one question for the Flame in Freefall challenge: "How well does the NASA combustion evidence actually cover the conditions I care about?"

We synthesized NASA PSI's microgravity combustion records into a deterministic evidence engine. A user describes a scenario, such as a lunar habitat at 30% O₂ and 10.2 psi, and Prometeo compares it against what has really been tested. Each condition is labeled studied, near, not covered, scarce evidence or not studied, and every number traces back to a source file, row and DOI.

The result is a map of what is known and what is missing. For example, 0 of 268 solid-fuel tests record pressure, and the highest O₂ ever tested on solids is 22.2%, far below the lunar scenario. Prometeo compares conditions. It never predicts whether something will burn.

The engine is domain-agnostic: all combustion knowledge enters through swappable data packs, so the same system can map evidence gaps in any research field, not just combustion.

It matters because fire-safety decisions for future crewed missions depend on knowing the limits of the evidence, not just its averages. Prometeo makes those limits visible, auditable and queryable in plain English.
details:
What it does. Prometeo ingests NASA PSI combustion test data into a structured "evidence pack." A deterministic engine then computes coverage levels, rankings, key findings and a machine-learning model card. The user gets a report with Key Findings, an Abstract, numbered figures and tables, Methods and References. They can ask questions in natural language, test their own scenario, and see exactly which studies are close and which gaps remain.

What makes it different

  • Evidence mapping, not prediction. Prometeo never says that something "burns" or "is safe". It says whether a condition is studied, near, not covered, scarce evidence or not studied. The gaps get the same visual weight as the findings, and no level is conveyed by color alone.
  • Full provenance. Every visible value carries its source (file and row, or document and page) and DOI. If there is no source, nothing is shown.
  • The AI never decides. Levels, rankings and findings come from a deterministic TypeScript engine with golden test vectors built from real data. The language model only (1) translates a question into schema-validated JSON and (2) drafts text that must pass a verifier. If the AI API fails, we show a template text clearly labeled as such. A recorded answer is never passed off as live AI.
  • Domain-agnostic engine. The engine has no combustion vocabulary. Everything specific enters through a pack, a mapping and a lens, and an automated check enforces this. The same engine can evaluate coverage in other scientific domains.
  • Scientific-article design. EB Garamond and Fira Sans, a single accent color, and no gradients or decorative effects. The content is academic and not simplified. What is friendly is the form, not a watered-down message.

Intended impact. Researchers and mission planners can see in seconds where the combustion evidence ends, so they can plan the next experiments around real gaps.

Tools and stack. TypeScript and React (Vite) for the web app and engine. Python 3.12, standard library only, for the data pipeline. AWS (CloudFront, Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, DynamoDB, SQS) deployed through idempotent AWS CLI scripts. Amazon Bedrock with Claude Haiku 4.5 through the official anthropic SDK. Vitest and pytest, with golden test vectors from real NASA data.

Factors we considered. Scientific honesty first (no invented data, no predictions), reproducibility (deterministic engine, provenance on every value), accessibility (nothing is encoded by color alone) and a strict split between what the engine computes and what the AI writes.

Live links. Code: https://github.com/FerGem33/prometeo-si · Deployed app: https://dursf4nho4zl6.cloudfront.net
